case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You raised alloy and material costs, and we take that seriously. Here is where the cost lines stand today:

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

Both lines have moved down, so the base price no longer has to carry a cost increase. What we offer in return is a longer contract term, which gives your capacity a more secure footing.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.79; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.84; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.81; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since you decide this together with colleagues, please take Option A up with the person who makes the final call on pricing. We would like this to be a fair solution for both family companies, built for the long run.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are pleased to accept the 24-month contract and 45-day payment terms; however, a fixed price over this period is not feasible, requiring an AS-14404 index clause. We have verified the recent decreases in the AS-14404 and PPI-C2431 indices and have reduced our price to reflect these market movements. Incorporating this index clause allows us to offer a revised unit price of EUR 5.40.

Our Angebot is a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You asked for an index clause on the alloy surcharge, and we have read your revised offer carefully.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 81.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70740@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.86; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.91; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.88; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As you do not decide alone on price, please take Option A to the person who does, and let us know the answer.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. I have discussed your request with management, and we acknowledge your note on our delivery performance. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. 

A fixed price over a 24-month term is not feasible, so we must retain the AS-14404 index clause. Incorporating this clause and your requested 45-day payment terms, we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 5.30. 

Our offer stands at a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit.

Please note that our offer is valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You asked for an index clause on the alloy surcharge, and we have read your revised offer with care. Our options below all carry a binding volume over the full contract term, which gives your free capacity a firm basis. Since the volume is binding, the price needs no clause to cover alloy swings.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.91; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.93; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 23,700 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve: it gives you the binding volume and the payment term you accepted yourself, at a price that works for both family companies. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Because price changes may need sign-off on your side, could you take Option A to the colleague who decides? It is one clear yes for a long, steady relationship, and we would be glad to settle it with you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
